metadata.short_desc: Search manager: division of labor, fallback, spending caps and call log
metadata.desc: Lets DeepSeek search, Tavily, AstrBot's built-in web search and community search plugins work together by specialty: general search, technical questions and specialists for images, videos, papers, GitHub and more. DeepSeek first with automatic fallback on outages or spending caps, search tool health checks, setup checks and network notes, per-tool usage stats, a call log for all tools and a dashboard.

api_key.hint: Leave empty to reuse the key of an existing DeepSeek provider (api_base on api.deepseek.com).

labels: Pause DeepSeek, use other search tools
routing_mode.hint: "Guide only" keeps every tool and states priorities in the guide, so the tool list never changes and prompt caching is never invalidated. "DeepSeek first" hides overlapping tools while DeepSeek works; each switch invalidates the cache once.

fallback_tool_patterns.hint: Tool names matching these patterns (* wildcard) are hidden while DeepSeek works and shown when it doesn't.

include_content.description: Include page content in search results

record_queries.description: Show recent queries in the dashboard

call_log_enabled.hint: Records calls of all tools, not only DeepSeek, in calls.db under the plugin data directory.

call_log_record_other_content.description: Record full args and results of other tools
call_log_record_other_content.hint: By default only name, source, duration and status are kept for other tools.

billing_currency.hint: Match your DeepSeek account. Costs and spending caps use this currency.

daily_budget.hint: In the billing currency. 0 means unlimited.

monthly_budget.hint: In the billing currency, calendar month. 0 means unlimited.

exchange_rate.hint: Only used to show costs in the other currency.

specialist_rules.hint: One per line: "tool pattern = what it is good at" (* wildcard). Matching tools are kept as specialists and described to the model.

inject_search_guide.description: Tell the model which search tool does what
inject_search_guide.hint: Appends a short, stable guide listing only the tools available in the request.

own_tools_enabled.description: Enable DeepDeep's own search and fetch
own_tools_enabled.hint: When off, deepdeep_web_search / deepdeep_web_fetch are removed from each request (AstrBot's tool switches are not touched) and other search tools take over; the guide, call log and health checks keep working.

tavily_enabled.hint: Provides deepdeep_tavily_search, the first choice for technical questions (programming, versions, CVEs, official docs) and DeepSeek's first fallback. Reuses the Tavily key from AstrBot's web search settings, even when the built-in provider is something else. Not offered without a key or when the built-in provider already is Tavily.

tavily_api_key.hint: Leave empty to reuse the Tavily key from AstrBot's web search settings.

tavily_monthly_limit.hint: Counts successful deepdeep_tavily_search calls per calendar month (cache hits don't count). Once reached, the tool is not offered for the rest of the month and technical questions go to other search tools; it comes back next month. 0 = no cap. The Tavily free tier is 1000 calls a month; set it a bit lower if AstrBot's built-in Tavily search shares the key.

tool_monthly_limits.description: Monthly call caps for other search tools
tool_monthly_limits.hint: One per line: "tool pattern = count" (* wildcard), e.g. web_search_bocha = 500. Counts successful calls per calendar month (tools matching the same line are added up). Once reached, the tools are removed from each request for the rest of the month (AstrBot's tool switches are not touched). DeepDeep's own tools have their own limits.

panel_language.hint: Language of the plugin dashboard. "Follow AstrBot" uses the current language of the AstrBot dashboard.

search_lane_rules.hint: One per line: "question type = tool pattern, tool pattern" (* wildcard). The first tool present in the request becomes the first choice for that type and is written into the guide; other questions still go to DeepDeep first.

search_preference.hint: Which search tool goes first for each kind of question. Recommended: the default order from the 2026-10 evaluation; Save money: self-hosted and free-tier tools first; Chinese sources first: tools with good Chinese coverage first; Custom: use "Custom search order" below. You can reorder directly on the dashboard's Settings page.

search_order.hint: Used when the search preference is "Custom". One per line: "scene = tool pattern, tool pattern"; scenes are general, tech and read. Earlier tools go first; prefix ! to not use one. Easier to set on the dashboard, which writes this for you.
